requireMarker.reason: The repository README ships only once it is the public README and carries the line <!-- quiettv:public -->. Without it this is the private workspace README and stays out.

notExported.reason: Launcher UI source. Exported only with --with-frontend, through public-toolkit/frontend-export.json and its transforms (unconfigured weather location, no icons extracted from the TV, PNG metadata removed).

RELEASE BLOCKER: native .NET launcher host the TV runs (Program.cs, State.cs, RemoteGate.cs, WebFrontend.cs and others). Device-side and not positively audited for a public build. Without it the frontend has no TV-side host.

RELEASE BLOCKER: the registered Home widget (config.xml, icon.png, bridge.js, home.js, tv-inputs.js), its privileged on-boot service (service/) and native payload (payload/*.dll), plus early-boot work and device captures from the owner's TV. Device-side; config.xml names the owner and points at the excluded service. Never exported.
RELEASE BLOCKER: the IPTV player (C# host plus web app). Not positively audited; bundles third-party scripts (an Anthropic SDK build, hls.js, a QR library) whose licences are not yet recorded.
Third-party root payload. This toolkit is not a root bypass and does not redistribute it.
Owner backups, keys and stock payloads. Never exported.
Session notes about the owner's TV, network and home. Not public documentation. docs/screenshots/ ships when present, after the same scans.
Privileged transport and root tooling. Stays with the owner; the public toolkit ships no transport.
Raw device captures, results and screenshots from the owner's TV.

Export this package separately using its positive tracked file list and public_source_guard.py, including actual-owner deny hashes. Its documented synthetic MAC/LAN and planted-secret fixtures intentionally fail this toolkit generic scanner. Do not relax either scanner or publish the private repository/history.
